address: 165-167 Nui Thanh Street, Hoa Cuong Bac Ward, Hai Chau District, Da Nang, 550000, Vietnam
bio: Spread across two floors, you may need to share a table at this lively local spot – a testament to its authentic Vietnamese fare. Straw chandeliers and local-style paintings add charm. The menu focuses on two dishes: Mỳ Quảng, a local speciality made with soft, fragrant flat rice noodles and varied toppings; and Bánh Thịt Heo, boiled pork belly wrapped in rice paper and herbs, served with a tangy dipping sauce made from fermented anchovy and tropical fruits....
